name: Adobe Marketo Engage
description: Adobe Marketo Engage is an enterprise marketing automation platform for B2B organizations, covering lead management, account-based marketing, email marketing, and cross-channel campaign orchestration with real-time behavioral data.
best_for: Positioned for enterprise B2B marketing and sales teams that need to manage complex, multi-decision-maker buying committees across the full lead and account lifecycle.
cons: No public pricing of any kind is published; every plan requires a sales conversation before a buyer sees a number.
Positioned and priced for enterprise B2B marketing teams, with the buying-committee/ABM feature set to match -- a mismatch for a small team's simpler campaign needs.
As an Adobe Experience Cloud product, deep evaluation typically means engaging Adobe's own sales process rather than a self-serve trial.
features: Lead management with drill-down into lead, contact, account, and opportunity details
Account-based marketing (ABM) with Target Account Management for predictive, AI-powered ideal customer profile scoring
Sales Insight for keeping marketing and sales teams synced on account activity
Real-time lead and account activity tracking, including email opens and website visits
Audience building based on roles, intent signals, and buying stage
